scope: The new normal and actual High Contrast UX suites passed; the full desktop suite subsequently stopped at an obsolete formula status assertion. This is not whole-workflow acceptance.

Checks: Requested operating-system High Contrast is active
Shown native caption and content captured for Light, Dark and System without recreating the window
Initial query result preserves keyboard focus
Separate editor/preview counts, initial focus, forward/backward wrap, F3, empty/missing and cross-inline selection
Replacement invalidation, exact Undo and live/reset document zoom
Actual Copy image pixels exclude temporary relationship/entity highlighting
Pan beyond viewport and outside mouse release preserve entity selection
Inspection, pan, zoom and copy preserve source and saved bytes
